## Reference books

No textbook is required. Lecture notes, research articles and selected readings are provided during the semester. Useful references:

1. Robert, C. P., and Casella, G. (2004). *Monte Carlo Statistical Methods* (2nd ed.). Springer.
2. Gentle, J. E. (2009). *Computational Statistics* (2nd ed.). Springer.
3. Liu, J. S. (2001). *Monte Carlo Strategies in Scientific Computing*. Springer.
4. Brooks, S., Gelman, A., Jones, G., and Meng, X.-L. (2011). *Handbook of Markov Chain Monte Carlo*. CRC Press.
